output.scope_note: The paper reports an ionic conductivity of about 10^-3 S.cm-1 at room temperature for Rb2Ti2O5-δ, which the authors call a superionic conductor.

records.evidence_quote: The ionic conductivity σI extracted from the I-V measurements is of the order of 10−3 S.cm−1 at room temperature which makes this material a superionic conductor.
records.notes: Mobile species is not identified by the paper (oxygen ions/vacancies are suggested but not established, and protons/hydroxide are not excluded), so mobile_ion is set to 'other'. The value is given as 'of the order of' 10−3 S.cm−1, not a precise measurement. Measured on mostly single crystals in the activated (reduced) state with unspecified δ. The abstract gives the same value. The mobile ion is not established by the paper.
